spec: Human sets high-level outcome ("I want this outcome"). Does not micromanage or babysit.
Chief translates outcome into 1 canonical high-level goal. Does not play Courier.
Courier discovers, plans, negotiates, stamps, dispatches, executes, verifies, and updates state.
Worker executes bounded work unit; reports work_unit_complete; never sets global saturation.
Resource-aware NTFS writer mutex with hierarchical path containment and case-folding.
PROPOSED -> NEGOTIATING -> APPROVED_FOR_DISPATCH -> STAMPED -> DISPATCHED -> IN_FLIGHT -> RESULT_RECEIVED -> VERIFIED -> CLOSED.
Pre-dispatch dialogue: ACCEPT, QUESTION, CONFLICT, NEEDS_SCOPE_CHANGE, BETTER_ALTERNATIVE, UNSAFE, ALREADY_DONE.
Signed token SHA-256(taskId:version:goalId:scopePaths:maxCap).
Admissibility choke point: GREEN_CARD, REVISE, HOLD, BLOCK, ESCALATE.
Exit code 0, artifact manifest, SHA-256 checksums, zero prose proof.
PID + start time epoch + task token to prevent recycled PID collisions.
12-state process monitor; 5m progress check; 15m diagnostics; time alone never terminates.
On startup: verified evidence -> VERIFIED; in-flight -> EXECUTION_UNCERTAIN; no start proof -> consider retry.
Capture ideas while worker busy: CAPTURED, CANDIDATE, APPROVED_NEXT, MERGED, DISPATCHED.
ResearchFrontier, WorkGenerator, WorkScorer, WorkScheduler, FrontierReplenisher.
When ready high-value work < 5, automatically trigger discovery and replenish.
Score by goal relevance, risk, uncertainty reduction, info gain, dependency unlock, economic value, cost, machine suitability, novelty.
Reject duplicate green tests, arbitrary test count inflation, sleep loops, busy loops, fake gigabytes.
Explicit gating for 2FA, biometric signing, legal spend, external publish/deploy.
Evidence-first simulation only; views != revenue, clicks != revenue, simulation != revenue; €0 ceiling.
